payload.comment: The preprocessing and profiling stages have identified several risks and ambiguities that need to be addressed, particularly related to class interpretation and dataset variability. These issues should be carefully managed to ensure the robustness and reliability of the model.
llm_issues: Mix of tissue types and cancer stages may lead to interpretation variability
Class imbalance could affect model performance
Potential for misclassification exists, especially for less common classes
Need for expert validation to ensure accurate class labels
Limited test domain, with test images from a different clinical center
Dataset shift between training and test sets could impact model generalization
